name: SeaArt
tagline: SeaArt is a web-based AI image generation platform powered by Stable Diffusion with advanced features including ControlNet, LoRA models, and an AI canvas. It hosts thousands of community-shared models and workflows. Its generous free tier and professional tools attract both casual users and serious digital artists.
